en: This is the museum's library. Every book here is about Unova's past.
I'm reading about the dragon in the tower up north. It's a scary story.
I'm waiting for my brother. He reads so slowly!
A book about Unova's founding. The two brothers and their dragon are on every page.
A book about fossils. Rocks with shells in them, and rocks with bones.
A book about the Skyarrow Bridge. It took years to build.
A book about the old warehouses. The city once moved goods all over Unova.
A book of paintings. Many are of Nacrene City.
A book of old maps. Some of the roads have changed names.
A book about meteorites. Some fell near the Giant Chasm.
A book about Pokémon of the forest. The pictures are beautiful.
A book of folk tales. The dragon of Dragonspiral Tower is in most of them.
A book about museums. This one is in it, of course.
